_comment: The only catalog and app-update hosts. Fetched origins must also appear in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json connect-src; node tools/check-hosts.mjs enforces that. The default catalog is a public repo you create (ChamberTechFPS/GameOptimizer-catalog). Do not point catalogUrl at the private app repo: raw.githubusercontent.com returns 404 for private files, and players then never receive signed configs. chambertech.net or GitHub Pages are fine too; add that origin to the CSP. releasesUrl is the releases list, not /releases/latest, because /latest hides prereleases. See RELEASING.md.
